# PATTERN REVIEW

## Summary

* **Pattern Name:** `<Title>`
* **Submission Source:** (pick one) 
  * [ ] Community
  * [ ] Self-authored
  * [ ] AI-assisted
  * [ ] Legacy
* **Reviewed by:** `Name`
* **Date:** `YYYY-MM-DD`

---

## Relevance & Fit

| Question                                                       | Response                  |
|----------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| **Does this pattern fit the tone and purpose of the library?** | Yes / No                  |
| **Does it reflect a real, recurring problem?**                 | Yes / No                  |
| **Is the solution practical, realistic, and adaptable?**       | Yes / No                  |
| **Does it align with an existing category or tag?**            | Yes / No (add suggestion) |
| **Is it clearly distinct from existing patterns?**             | Yes / No (list overlaps)  |

---

## 5-Dimensional Value Reassessment

| Dimension                 | Score  | Notes / Adjustments |
|---------------------------|:------:|---------------------|
| **Short-term utility**    | `0–10` |                     |
| **Ease of adoption**      | `0–10` |                     |
| **Team facilitation fit** | `0–10` |                     |
| **Reusability**           | `0–10` |                     |
| **Novelty**               | `0–10` |                     |

---

## Review Comments

### Strengths
> What aspects of the suggestion stand out? (Clarity, relevance, phrasing, naming, framing...)

### Concerns or Gaps
> What might need improvement? (Lack of examples, unclear rationale, vague boundaries, overlap…)

### Suggestions for Improvement
> Concrete steps or questions that could guide a revision.

---

## Recommendation

- [ ] **Accept/Keep as-is**
- [ ] **Accept/Keep with minor revisions**
- [ ] **Request major revision**
- [ ] **Archive / Reject (with rationale)**

---

## Additional Notes (optional)

> Any thoughts on where this fits within your evolving body of work, or links to related entries for cross-referencing.
